opponent_rule: Your act must always be the same mission as your pledge. If you pledge scout, you act scout. Choose the pledge you actually want to carry out, then carry it out.

At the reveal stage you must publish exactly the three digits you sealed at the commit stage, unchanged. Never publish a different code, even one with the same security digit.
